title: Sovereign Engine command batch (sovereign.command_batch v1)
description: Wire contract for scene edit batches (TDD v0.1 section 19.2). RECONSTRUCTED from the TDD because the original packet fixture was not supplied; reconcile with Matthew's original if it exists. This schema describes shape only. The engine (engine/commands) implements and enforces the semantics: staged whole-batch validation in array order, base_revision equality, idempotency scoped to (scene, actor) and bound to the request-content hash, dry runs that never write or reserve keys, one revision increment per committed non-empty batch. Undo and redo are history-service calls (sovereign-cli scene undo/redo), not batch operations.

request_id.description: Transport identity of this delivery. Not part of the content hash: a retry may carry a new request_id.

actor.description: Who is asking (e.g. agent:layout-bot, cli:matthew). Idempotency keys are scoped per actor.

base_revision.description: Revision the batch was prepared against. Any other current revision is rejected as stale_revision.

dry_run.description: Defaults to true: a batch must explicitly set false to commit.

entity_create.description: Creates an entity with an explicit stable id. Component fields omitted here take their documented defaults; unknown components/fields are rejected. A parent must exist (possibly created earlier in the same batch).

components.description: Same component objects as scene.schema.json#/$defs/components, with every field optional.

transform.description: Complete local position/rotation/scale. parent is optional: omitted keeps the current parent; null moves the entity to the scene root. Cycles and missing parents are rejected.

material_set.description: Sets one or more material fields on an entity that has a material component (component_missing otherwise).

entity_delete.description: Rejected (missing_dependency) while children reference the entity or it is the scene's active_camera. No cascading delete: delete or re-parent dependents earlier in the same batch.
